script_directives: Keep total duration strictly between 20-22 seconds to maximize completion rate.
Eliminate preamble; start the hook within the first 1.5 seconds using high-contrast visual text overlays.
Use a 'problem-solution' structure where the first 10 seconds define the threat and the final 10 seconds provide a clear, actionable pivot.
seo_directives: Use high-intent keywords in the title that address specific pain points (e.g., 'Trap', 'Stop', 'Discount').
Limit hashtags to 3-4 highly relevant tags (e.g., #FinanceIndia, #StockMarketIndia, #InvestingTips) to avoid algorithmic dilution.
